ask: can u make a poll where we each rank our top 3 of these places
sentence: Lets each person pick and order their top 3 from a fixed list of options, scoring 3, 2 and 1 points for first, second and third, and shows a live points tally.
use_when: a group wants to rank their top 3 from a short list of places or options
a plain one-choice vote would hide how strongly people prefer things
deciding on a trip destination, restaurant, or activity as a group
each person should be able to change or clear their picks before deciding
dont_use_when: a simple single-choice yes/no or one-vote poll is enough
people need to rank every option in a full order
the options list must be added to or edited by members
a scheduling or availability poll for dates and times is needed
